webtoolsmanager-desc: Kordhinta MediaWiki oo bixisa is-dhexgal isticmaale oo loogu talagalay maaraynta aaladaha webka ee wiki-yada, sida Open Graph, falanqaynta, iwm.
webtoolsmanager-error-nopermission: {{GENDER:$1|Adigu}} ma lihid oggolaanshaha aad ku geli karto boggan.
webtoolsmanager-form-analytics-google-id: Aqoonsiga mashruucan raadraaca. Ka tag meel bannaan si aan Google Analytics loo isticmaalin gabi ahaanba.
Aqoonsiga la bixiyay waa mid qaab ahaan khaldan. Fadlan isticmaal aqoonsi Google Analytics oo sax ah
webtoolsmanager-form-opengraph-fallbackO: U isticmaal astaanta wiki-ga beddel ahaan
Haddii maqaalka aan laga helin sawir, u isticmaal astaanta wiki-ga beddel ahaan meta calaamada `image`
webtoolsmanager-form-opengraph-descripti: Sharaxaadda ka soo muuqan doonta summadaha kooban ee bogga hore, iyo bog kasta oo aan lahayn kooban u gaar ah. Ka gudub meel bannaan haddii aan la doonayn wax sharaxaad ah.
